## Step 14: Calibration-Only Timing and Sizing Research

The calibration is carried out entirely within this notebook. It has no
access to future observations when forming annual signal normalizers. Outright
sizing volatility is initialized with executable history from 1990 and is
strictly lagged, so the January 2000 position uses only 1990--1999 returns.

```{r optimization-engine, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
#############################################################################
# 14.0 Frozen research choices
#############################################################################

OPT_CAL_END <- as.Date("2016-12-31")
OPT_OOS_START <- as.Date("2017-01-01")
OPT_INITIAL_CAPITAL <- 1e6
OPT_RISK_SCALE <- 0.20 / sqrt(52)
OPT_MIN_CONTRACTS <- 1L
OPT_MIN_TRADES <- 15L

# Outright performance-bond framework. The construction is the same as the RV 
# strategy: maintenance is conservatively rounded, HRP initial margin is 110%
# of maintenance rounded to the next $250, and the primary capacity constraint
# uses twice initial margin with at most 80% of start-of-week equity committed
# under stress. Margin limits feasibility only; it is not an alpha or sizing
# target. The historical-stress column is a frozen robustness scenario and is
# never used to select a strategy specification.
OPT_MARGIN_SCHEDULE <- data.frame(
  contract_rank = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 9L, 13L, 17L),
  cme_reference_date = as.Date("2025-12-26"),
  cme_reference_long = c(4225, 4132, 3924, 3746, 3383, 3110, 2794),
  cme_reference_short = c(3732, 3547, 3314, 3135, 2776, 2494, 2258),
  maintenance = c(4250, 4250, 4000, 3750, 3500, 3250, 3000),
  initial = c(4750, 4750, 4500, 4250, 4000, 3750, 3500),
  stress_primary = c(9500, 9500, 9000, 8500, 8000, 7500, 7000),
  historical_reference_date = as.Date("2022-03-21"),
  historical_exchange_margin = c(12000, 10500, 9500, 7800, 6800, 6400, 5900),
  stress_historical = c(13250, 11750, 10500, 8750, 8000, 7500, 7000),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
OPT_MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION <- 0.80
OPT_TBILL_HAIRCUT <- 0.005

margin_terms <- function(contract_rank,
                         margin_scenario = c("primary", "historical")) {
  margin_scenario <- match.arg(margin_scenario)
  row <- OPT_MARGIN_SCHEDULE[
    OPT_MARGIN_SCHEDULE$contract_rank == as.integer(contract_rank), , drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(row) != 1L) stop("No outright-margin terms for CL", contract_rank)
  list(
    maintenance = row$maintenance,
    initial = row$initial,
    stress = if (margin_scenario == "primary") row$stress_primary else
      row$stress_historical,
    scenario = margin_scenario
  )
}

MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS <- c(1L, 5L, 9L, 13L, 17L)
DEVIATION_ROBUSTNESS_RANKS <- c(2L, 3L)
OPT_COSTS <- c(`1` = 12.50, `2` = 12.50, `3` = 12.50,
               `5` = 15.00, `9` = 17.50, `13` = 20.00, `17` = 22.50)

entry_grid <- c(0.50, 1.00, 1.50, 2.00)
exit_grid <- c(0.00, 0.50, 1.00)
time_stop_grid <- c(Inf, 26, 52)
broad_grid <- expand.grid(entry = entry_grid, exit = exit_grid,
                          time_stop = time_stop_grid) |>
  dplyr::filter(exit < entry) |>
  dplyr::arrange(time_stop, entry, exit)
stopifnot(nrow(broad_grid) == 27L)

sizing_design <- data.frame(
  sizing_mode = c("fixed_entry", "fixed_entry", "fixed_entry", "weekly_resize"),
  ema_half_life = c(26L, 13L, 52L, 26L),
  research_role = c("primary", "half-life sensitivity", "half-life sensitivity",
                    "resizing sensitivity"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

#############################################################################
# 2. General execution, filtering, signal and sizing helpers
#############################################################################

build_execution_for_indices <- function(contract_rank, current_indices,
                                        output_dates = obs_dates[current_indices]) {
  current_indices <- as.integer(current_indices)
  if (!length(current_indices) || any(current_indices <= 1L)) {
    stop("Execution indices must contain at least one interval with a prior week")
  }
  n <- length(current_indices)
  target_ticker <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  price_prev <- price_curr <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  ltd_curr <- as.Date(rep(NA_real_, n), origin = "1970-01-01")
  exec_roll <- logical(n)
  held_ticker <- NA_character_

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    idx_now <- current_indices[i]
    idx_prev <- idx_now - 1L
    prev_px <- PX_ALL[idx_prev, , drop = TRUE]
    prev_und <- UND_ALL[idx_prev, , drop = TRUE]
    prev_ltd <- LTD_ALL[idx_prev, , drop = TRUE]
    curr_px <- PX_ALL[idx_now, , drop = TRUE]
    curr_und <- UND_ALL[idx_now, , drop = TRUE]
    curr_ltd <- LTD_ALL[idx_now, , drop = TRUE]
    old_ticker <- held_ticker

    held_ticker <- choose_execution_ticker(
      held_ticker = held_ticker,
      generic_ticker_next = UND_ALL[idx_now, contract_rank],
      prev_und_row = prev_und,
      prev_ltd_row = prev_ltd,
      next_obs_date = obs_dates[idx_now]
    )
    p0 <- lookup_ticker_price(prev_px, prev_und, held_ticker)
    p1 <- lookup_ticker_price(curr_px, curr_und, held_ticker)
    ltd <- lookup_ticker_ltd(curr_ltd, curr_und, held_ticker)
    if (!is.finite(p0) || !is.finite(p1) || p0 <= 0 || p1 <= 0) {
      stop("Invalid executable price for rank ", contract_rank,
           " on ", obs_dates[idx_now])
    }
    target_ticker[i] <- held_ticker
    price_prev[i] <- p0
    price_curr[i] <- p1
    ltd_curr[i] <- ltd
    exec_roll[i] <- i > 1L && !is.na(old_ticker) && old_ticker != held_ticker
  }

  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(output_dates), contract_rank = contract_rank,
    target_ticker = target_ticker, price_prev = price_prev,
    price_curr = price_curr, ltd_curr = ltd_curr, exec_roll = exec_roll,
    unit_long_gross = (price_curr - price_prev) * DIRECTIONAL_CONTRACT_SIZE,
    realized_log_change = log(price_curr / price_prev),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

filter_training_states <- function(theta, end_idx) {
  idx <- seq_len(end_idx)
  ss <- make_ss_arrays(theta, Tau[, idx, drop = FALSE], DELTA_T)
  masked <- apply_missing_mask_fkf(Y[, idx, drop = FALSE], ss)
  prior <- tryCatch(
    compute_prior_from_first_L(masked$Zt, masked$ct, masked$yt,
                               L = max(4L, min(6L, length(idx))), inflate = 2.0),
    error = function(e) list(m0 = c(0, 0), P0 = diag(1e6, 2))
  )
  fit <- FKF::fkf(a0 = prior$m0, P0 = prior$P0,
                  dt = masked$dt, ct = masked$ct,
                  Tt = masked$Tt, Zt = masked$Zt,
                  HHt = masked$HHt, GGt = masked$GGt, yt = masked$yt)
  fit$att
}

forecast_gap_from_state <- function(theta, chi, xi, execution, i) {
  chi_next <- exp(-theta$kappa * DELTA_T) * chi
  xi_next <- xi + theta$mu * DELTA_T
  tau_next <- max(as.numeric(execution$ltd_curr[i] - execution$date[i]) / 365.25, 0)
  predicted <- exp(-theta$kappa * tau_next) * chi_next + xi_next +
    A_fun(tau_next, theta$kappa, theta$mu_star, theta$sigma_chi,
          theta$sigma_xi, theta$rho, theta$lambda_chi)
  predicted - log(execution$price_prev[i])
}

lagged_ema_sd <- function(x, half_life) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  if (length(x) < 2L) return(out)
  lambda <- exp(log(0.5) / half_life)
  weight_sum <- weighted_sum <- weighted_square_sum <- 0
  n_seen <- 0L
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    if (n_seen >= 2L && weight_sum > 0) {
      mu <- weighted_sum / weight_sum
      variance <- max(weighted_square_sum / weight_sum - mu^2, 0)
      out[i] <- sqrt(variance)
    }
    if (is.finite(x[i])) {
      weight_sum <- lambda * weight_sum + 1
      weighted_sum <- lambda * weighted_sum + x[i]
      weighted_square_sum <- lambda * weighted_square_sum + x[i]^2
      n_seen <- n_seen + 1L
    }
  }
  out
}

threshold_positions <- function(score, entry, exit, time_stop) {
  if (!(entry > exit && exit >= 0)) stop("Thresholds require entry > exit >= 0")
  n <- length(score)
  position <- integer(n)
  current <- 0L
  held_weeks <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    s <- score[i]
    if (!is.finite(s)) {
      position[i] <- current
      next
    }
    if (current == 0L) {
      if (s >= entry) current <- 1L
      if (s <= -entry) current <- -1L
      held_weeks <- if (current == 0L) 0L else 1L
    } else {
      time_exit <- is.finite(time_stop) && held_weeks >= time_stop
      convergence_exit <- abs(s) <= exit
      reverse_to <- if (s >= entry) 1L else if (s <= -entry) -1L else 0L
      if (time_exit || convergence_exit) {
        current <- 0L
        held_weeks <- 0L
      } else if (reverse_to != 0L && reverse_to != current) {
        current <- reverse_to
        held_weeks <- 1L
      } else {
        held_weeks <- held_weeks + 1L
      }
    }
    position[i] <- current
  }
  position
}

count_trade_entries <- function(position) {
  prev <- c(0L, head(position, -1L))
  sum(position != 0L & position != prev)
}

simulate_outright <- function(execution, position, cost_per_side,
                              sizing_mode = c("unit", "fixed_entry", "weekly_resize"),
                              ema_half_life = 26L, strategy_id = "candidate",
                              add_terminal_liquidation = TRUE,
                              margin_scenario = c("primary", "historical")) {
  sizing_mode <- match.arg(sizing_mode)
  margin_scenario <- match.arg(margin_scenario)
  n <- nrow(execution)
  stopifnot(length(position) == n, all(position %in% c(-1L, 0L, 1L)))
  rank <- unique(execution$contract_rank)
  if (length(rank) != 1L) stop("Each outright simulation must use one maturity")
  margin <- margin_terms(rank, margin_scenario)
  vol_history <- sizing_volatility_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  vol_column <- paste0("ema_sd_", as.integer(ema_half_life))
  if (is.null(vol_history) || !vol_column %in% names(vol_history)) {
    stop("Missing strictly historical sizing volatility for CL", rank,
         " and half-life ", ema_half_life)
  }
  vol_match <- match(execution$date, vol_history$date)
  if (anyNA(vol_match)) {
    stop("Sizing-volatility history does not cover every execution date for CL", rank)
  }
  vol <- vol_history[[vol_column]][vol_match]
  if (any(!is.finite(vol) | vol <= 0)) {
    stop("Strictly lagged sizing volatility is invalid for CL", rank)
  }
  signed_quantity <- integer(n)
  contracts <- desired_contracts <- margin_capacity <- integer(n)
  sides <- integer(n)
  gross <- costs <- net <- tbill_pnl <- total <- capital <- numeric(n)
  capital_start <- numeric(n)
  margin_posted <- maintenance_required <- stress_required <- numeric(n)
  stress_limit <- stress_util_start <- stress_util_end <- numeric(n)
  margin_face_value <- idle_cash <- gross_notional <- numeric(n)
  margin_cap_binding <- margin_entry_cap <- margin_forced_reduction <- logical(n)
  maintenance_margin_call <- logical(n)
  margin_action <- rep("none", n)
  capital_running <- OPT_INITIAL_CAPITAL
  current_contracts <- 0L

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    pos_now <- position[i]
    pos_prev <- if (i == 1L) 0L else position[i - 1L]
    q_prev <- if (i == 1L) 0L else signed_quantity[i - 1L]
    is_new_trade <- pos_now != 0L &&
      (pos_prev == 0L || pos_prev != pos_now || current_contracts == 0L)
    capital_start[i] <- capital_running

    if (pos_now == 0L) {
      current_contracts <- 0L
    } else if (sizing_mode == "unit") {
      current_contracts <- 1L
    } else if (is_new_trade || sizing_mode == "weekly_resize") {
      sd_i <- vol[i]
      raw_n <- round((OPT_RISK_SCALE * capital_running) / sd_i)
      current_contracts <- max(OPT_MIN_CONTRACTS, as.integer(raw_n))
    }

    # Match the RV ordering: determine the desired risk-sized position first,
    # then allow the stressed-margin rule only to reduce it. There is no fixed
    # contract ceiling and no gross-notional-to-equity ceiling.
    desired_i <- if (pos_now == 0L) 0L else current_contracts
    capacity_i <- max(0L, as.integer(floor(
      OPT_MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION * max(capital_running, 0) / margin$stress
    )))
    feasible_i <- min(desired_i, capacity_i)
    binding_i <- desired_i > capacity_i
    margin_cap_binding[i] <- binding_i
    margin_entry_cap[i] <- is_new_trade && binding_i
    margin_forced_reduction[i] <- !is_new_trade && binding_i
    if (binding_i) {
      margin_action[i] <- if (is_new_trade && feasible_i == 0L) {
        "entry_blocked"
      } else if (is_new_trade) {
        "entry_capped"
      } else if (feasible_i == 0L) {
        "forced_flat"
      } else {
        "forced_reduction"
      }
    }
    desired_contracts[i] <- desired_i
    margin_capacity[i] <- capacity_i
    current_contracts <- feasible_i
    contracts[i] <- current_contracts
    q_now <- pos_now * current_contracts
    signed_quantity[i] <- q_now

    ticker_changed <- i > 1L && execution$target_ticker[i] != execution$target_ticker[i - 1L]
    sides[i] <- if (ticker_changed && (q_prev != 0L || q_now != 0L)) {
      abs(q_prev) + abs(q_now)
    } else {
      abs(q_now - q_prev)
    }
    if (i == n && add_terminal_liquidation) sides[i] <- sides[i] + abs(q_now)

    gross[i] <- q_now * execution$unit_long_gross[i]
    costs[i] <- sides[i] * cost_per_side
    net[i] <- gross[i] - costs[i]
    margin_posted[i] <- margin$initial * current_contracts
    maintenance_required[i] <- margin$maintenance * current_contracts
    stress_required[i] <- margin$stress * current_contracts
    stress_limit[i] <- OPT_MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION * capital_running
    stress_util_start[i] <- if (capital_running > 0) {
      stress_required[i] / capital_running
    } else if (stress_required[i] > 0) Inf else 0
    margin_face_value[i] <- margin_posted[i] / (1 - OPT_TBILL_HAIRCUT)
    idle_cash[i] <- capital_running - margin_posted[i]
    if (idle_cash[i] < -1e-8 || stress_required[i] > stress_limit[i] + 1e-8) {
      stop("Outright margin invariant failed for ", strategy_id,
           " on ", execution$date[i])
    }
    weekly_rate <- directional_ref$tbill_rate_weekly[
      match(execution$date[i], directional_ref$date)
    ]
    if (!length(weekly_rate) || !is.finite(weekly_rate)) weekly_rate <- 0
    tbill_pnl[i] <- idle_cash[i] * weekly_rate
    total[i] <- net[i] + tbill_pnl[i]
    capital_running <- capital_running + total[i]
    capital[i] <- capital_running
    maintenance_margin_call[i] <- current_contracts > 0L &&
      capital_running < maintenance_required[i]
    stress_util_end[i] <- if (capital_running > 0) {
      stress_required[i] / capital_running
    } else if (stress_required[i] > 0) Inf else 0
    gross_notional[i] <- abs(q_now) * execution$price_prev[i] *
      DIRECTIONAL_CONTRACT_SIZE
  }

  data.frame(
    strategy_id = strategy_id, date = execution$date,
    contract_rank = execution$contract_rank,
    target_ticker = execution$target_ticker,
    price_prev = execution$price_prev, price_curr = execution$price_curr,
    direction = position, contracts = contracts,
    signed_quantity = signed_quantity, lagged_ema_dollar_sd = vol,
    unit_long_gross = execution$unit_long_gross,
    gross_futures_pnl = gross, contract_sides_traded = sides,
    transaction_cost = costs, net_futures_pnl = net,
    margin_scenario = margin_scenario,
    margin_per_contract_initial = margin$initial,
    margin_per_contract_maintenance = margin$maintenance,
    margin_per_contract_stress = margin$stress,
    margin_posted = margin_posted,
    maintenance_margin_required = maintenance_required,
    stress_margin_required = stress_required,
    stress_margin_limit = stress_limit,
    stress_margin_utilization_start = stress_util_start,
    stress_margin_utilization_end = stress_util_end,
    margin_face_value = margin_face_value,
    idle_cash = idle_cash,
    capital_start_week = capital_start, tbill_pnl = tbill_pnl,
    total_pnl = total, capital = capital,
    exec_roll = execution$exec_roll & signed_quantity != 0L,
    desired_contracts_before_margin = desired_contracts,
    margin_capacity_contracts = margin_capacity,
    margin_cap_binding = margin_cap_binding,
    margin_entry_cap = margin_entry_cap,
    margin_forced_reduction = margin_forced_reduction,
    margin_action = margin_action,
    maintenance_margin_call = maintenance_margin_call,
    gross_notional = gross_notional,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

summarise_run <- function(run, position) {
  x <- run$net_futures_pnl
  weekly_return <- x / run$capital_start_week
  period_start_capital <- run$capital_start_week[1L]
  eq <- period_start_capital + cumsum(x)
  peak <- cummax(c(period_start_capital, eq))[-1L]
  dd <- eq - peak
  data.frame(
    gross_futures_pnl = sum(run$gross_futures_pnl),
    transaction_cost = sum(run$transaction_cost),
    net_futures_pnl = sum(x),
    information_ratio = if (stats::sd(weekly_return) > 0) {
      mean(weekly_return) / stats::sd(weekly_return) * sqrt(52)
    } else NA_real_,
    max_drawdown_dollars = min(dd),
    max_drawdown_pct = 100 * min(dd / peak),
    completed_trades = count_trade_entries(position),
    contract_sides = sum(run$contract_sides_traded),
    max_contracts = max(run$contracts),
    margin_cap_bindings = sum(run$margin_cap_binding),
    margin_entry_caps = sum(run$margin_entry_cap),
    margin_forced_reductions = sum(run$margin_forced_reduction),
    maximum_stress_margin_utilization = max(run$stress_margin_utilization_start),
    maximum_gross_notional_to_equity = max(run$gross_notional /
                                             run$capital_start_week),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

#############################################################################
# 3. Build all live execution paths and correctly normalized signals
#############################################################################

trade_indices <- match(directional_ref$date, obs_dates)
if (anyNA(trade_indices)) stop("Directional trading dates do not align with obs_dates")
all_optimized_ranks <- sort(unique(c(MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS, DEVIATION_ROBUSTNESS_RANKS)))
execution_by_rank <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(all_optimized_ranks,
         function(r) build_execution_for_indices(r, trade_indices, directional_ref$date)),
  all_optimized_ranks
)

# Match the RV information convention: sizing history begins with the first
# executable interval in the 1990 estimation sample and is carried continuously
# through the final trading date. The EMA value attached to date t is computed
# before adding the return ending on t, so every volatility estimate uses only
# information available through t-1. No future-return fallback is permitted.
sizing_history_indices <- 2L:max(trade_indices)
sizing_execution_history_by_rank <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(all_optimized_ranks, function(r) {
    build_execution_for_indices(
      r, sizing_history_indices, obs_dates[sizing_history_indices]
    )
  }),
  all_optimized_ranks
)
sizing_half_lives <- sort(unique(as.integer(sizing_design$ema_half_life)))
sizing_volatility_by_rank <- lapply(sizing_execution_history_by_rank, function(execution) {
  out <- data.frame(date = execution$date)
  for (half_life in sizing_half_lives) {
    out[[paste0("ema_sd_", half_life)]] <- lagged_ema_sd(
      execution$unit_long_gross, half_life
    )
  }
  out
})

for (rank in all_optimized_ranks) {
  history <- sizing_execution_history_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  live <- execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  live_match <- match(live$date, history$date)
  if (anyNA(live_match) ||
      any(history$target_ticker[live_match] != live$target_ticker) ||
      max(abs(history$price_prev[live_match] - live$price_prev)) > 1e-10 ||
      max(abs(history$price_curr[live_match] - live$price_curr)) > 1e-10) {
    stop("Continuous sizing history does not reproduce the live CL", rank,
         " execution path")
  }
}

sizing_initialization_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all_optimized_ranks, function(rank) {
  history <- sizing_execution_history_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  volatility <- sizing_volatility_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  first_trade_date <- min(execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]$date)
  first_trade_row <- match(first_trade_date, volatility$date)
  data.frame(
    contract_rank = rank,
    sizing_history_start = min(history$date),
    first_trade_date = first_trade_date,
    observations_before_first_trade = sum(history$date < first_trade_date),
    ema_sd_13_at_first_trade = volatility$ema_sd_13[first_trade_row],
    ema_sd_26_at_first_trade = volatility$ema_sd_26[first_trade_row],
    ema_sd_52_at_first_trade = volatility$ema_sd_52[first_trade_row],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Check the generalized helper against the frozen CL1 path.
stopifnot(max(abs(execution_by_rank[["1"]]$price_prev - execution_CL1$price_prev)) < 1e-10)
stopifnot(max(abs(execution_by_rank[["1"]]$price_curr - execution_CL1$price_curr)) < 1e-10)

# Contrarian score: exact RV convention--empirical training-sample SD of
# filtered chi, with
# the theoretical stationary SD only as a fallback. The oriented score is
# positive for a desired long position.
z_deviation <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(directional_ref))
normalizer_deviation <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(directional_ref))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(directional_ref))) {
  th <- theta_by_year[[as.character(directional_ref$trading_year[i])]]
  empirical <- th$sigma_chi_emp
  theoretical <- th$sigma_chi / sqrt(2 * th$kappa)
  scale_i <- if (is.finite(empirical) && empirical > 0) empirical else theoretical
  normalizer_deviation[i] <- scale_i
  z_deviation[i] <- -decision_chi[i] / scale_i
}
stopifnot(all(is.finite(z_deviation)))

# Model-forecast score: for each annual model and each traded maturity, compute
# the empirical SD
# of historical one-week forecast gaps using only that year's training sample.
# This retains zero as the economic no-change boundary: the gaps are scaled,
# not demeaned. The annual normalizers are then frozen throughout the next year.
forecast_normalizers <- list()
forecast_training_gap_cache <- list()
max_training_end <- max(schedule$train_end_idx)
# Every annual training window starts in 1990, so the executable ticker path
# up to a given boundary is a prefix of one common path. Build that path once
# per maturity; annual estimation still refilters states separately.
training_execution_by_rank <- stats::setNames(
  lapply(MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS, function(rank) {
    build_execution_for_indices(rank, 2:max_training_end,
                                obs_dates[2:max_training_end])
  }),
  MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS
)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(schedule))) {
  yr <- schedule$trading_year[k]
  end_idx <- schedule$train_end_idx[k]
  th <- theta_list[[k]]
  states <- filter_training_states(th, end_idx)
  interval_idx <- 2:end_idx
  for (rank in MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS) {
    ex_train <- training_execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]][
      seq_len(length(interval_idx)), , drop = FALSE
    ]
    gaps <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(ex_train)), function(j) {
      forecast_gap_from_state(th, states[1L, j], states[2L, j], ex_train, j)
    }, numeric(1))
    gap_sd <- stats::sd(gaps, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(gap_sd) || gap_sd <= 0) stop("Invalid model-forecast training SD for ", yr, " CL", rank)
    key <- paste(yr, rank, sep = "_")
    forecast_training_gap_cache[[key]] <- gaps
    forecast_normalizers[[length(forecast_normalizers) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      trading_year = yr, contract_rank = rank,
      training_start = min(obs_dates[interval_idx]),
      training_end = max(obs_dates[interval_idx]),
      n_training_gaps = length(gaps), forecast_gap_sd = gap_sd
    )
  }
}
forecast_normalizers <- dplyr::bind_rows(forecast_normalizers)

forecast_signal_rows <- list()
for (rank in MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS) {
  execution <- execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  raw_gap <- z <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(directional_ref))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(directional_ref))) {
    yr <- directional_ref$trading_year[i]
    th <- theta_by_year[[as.character(yr)]]
    raw_gap[i] <- forecast_gap_from_state(th, decision_chi[i], decision_xi[i], execution, i)
    scale_i <- forecast_normalizers$forecast_gap_sd[
      forecast_normalizers$trading_year == yr & forecast_normalizers$contract_rank == rank
    ]
    if (length(scale_i) != 1L) stop("Missing model-forecast normalizer for ", yr, " CL", rank)
    z[i] <- raw_gap[i] / scale_i
  }
  forecast_signal_rows[[as.character(rank)]] <- data.frame(
    date = directional_ref$date, trading_year = directional_ref$trading_year,
    contract_rank = rank, raw_forecast_gap = raw_gap,
    z_model_forecast = z, realized_log_change = execution$realized_log_change
  )
}
forecast_signals <- dplyr::bind_rows(forecast_signal_rows)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(forecast_signals$z_model_forecast)))

# Raw one-contract baselines use only the economic sign of each signal. They
# contain no entry threshold, exit threshold, time stop, or risk scaling. The
# contrarian signal is applied to CL1 and the pre-specified CL2/CL3 robustness
# contracts; the model-forecast signal is reported for all five model
# maturities. These runs are descriptive baselines and never enter selection.
raw_baseline_runs <- list()
raw_deviation_position <- fill_zero_signal(z_deviation)
for (rank in c(1L, DEVIATION_ROBUSTNESS_RANKS)) {
  id <- paste0("RAW_DEV_CONTRARIAN_CL", rank)
  execution <- execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  raw_baseline_runs[[id]] <- list(
    position = raw_deviation_position,
    weekly = simulate_outright(
      execution, raw_deviation_position, OPT_COSTS[[as.character(rank)]],
      "unit", 26L, id, add_terminal_liquidation = TRUE
    )
  )
}
for (rank in MODEL_FORECAST_RANKS) {
  id <- paste0("RAW_MODEL_FORECAST_CL", rank)
  execution <- execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]]
  raw_position <- fill_zero_signal(
    forecast_signal_rows[[as.character(rank)]]$z_model_forecast
  )
  raw_baseline_runs[[id]] <- list(
    position = raw_position,
    weekly = simulate_outright(
      execution, raw_position, OPT_COSTS[[as.character(rank)]],
      "unit", 26L, id, add_terminal_liquidation = TRUE
    )
  )
}

#############################################################################
# 4. Calibration-only timing and sizing searches
#############################################################################

run_one_candidate <- function(score, execution, cost, entry, exit, time_stop,
                              sizing_mode = "unit", ema_half_life = 26L,
                              strategy_id = "candidate") {
  pos <- threshold_positions(score, entry, exit, time_stop)
  run <- simulate_outright(execution, pos, cost, sizing_mode, ema_half_life,
                           strategy_id, add_terminal_liquidation = TRUE)
  list(position = pos, weekly = run, summary = summarise_run(run, pos))
}

timing_search <- function(strategy_id, score_full, execution_full, cost) {
  cal <- execution_full$date <= OPT_CAL_END
  score <- score_full[cal]
  execution <- execution_full[cal, , drop = FALSE]

  broad_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(broad_grid)), function(i) {
    g <- broad_grid[i, ]
    out <- run_one_candidate(score, execution, cost, g$entry, g$exit,
                             g$time_stop, "unit", 26L,
                             paste0(strategy_id, "_broad_", i))
    cbind(strategy_id = strategy_id, candidate_id = i,
          entry = g$entry, exit = g$exit,
          time_stop = if (is.infinite(g$time_stop)) "none" else as.character(g$time_stop),
          out$summary)
  })
  broad <- dplyr::bind_rows(broad_rows)
  broad$eligible <- broad$completed_trades >= OPT_MIN_TRADES
  pool <- broad[broad$eligible, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(pool)) stop("No timing rule has at least ", OPT_MIN_TRADES, " trades: ", strategy_id)
  pool <- pool[order(-pool$net_futures_pnl), , drop = FALSE]
  centre <- pool[1L, , drop = FALSE]

  local_grid <- expand.grid(
    entry = sort(unique(c(centre$entry - 0.25, centre$entry, centre$entry + 0.25))),
    exit = sort(unique(c(centre$exit - 0.25, centre$exit, centre$exit + 0.25))),
    time_stop = time_stop_grid
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(entry > 0, exit >= 0, exit < entry) |>
    dplyr::arrange(time_stop, entry, exit)
  local_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(local_grid)), function(i) {
    g <- local_grid[i, ]
    out <- run_one_candidate(score, execution, cost, g$entry, g$exit,
                             g$time_stop, "unit", 26L,
                             paste0(strategy_id, "_local_", i))
    cbind(strategy_id = strategy_id, local_id = i,
          entry = g$entry, exit = g$exit,
          time_stop = if (is.infinite(g$time_stop)) "none" else as.character(g$time_stop),
          out$summary)
  })
  local <- dplyr::bind_rows(local_rows)

  # The broad-leading entry/exit pair is fixed. All three time stops proceed
  # to sizing, so time-stop selection cannot import information from local cells.
  sizing_rows <- list()
  row_id <- 0L
  for (stop_value in time_stop_grid) {
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(sizing_design))) {
      row_id <- row_id + 1L
      out <- run_one_candidate(
        score, execution, cost, centre$entry, centre$exit, stop_value,
        sizing_design$sizing_mode[j], sizing_design$ema_half_life[j],
        paste0(strategy_id, "_sizing_", row_id)
      )
      sizing_rows[[row_id]] <- cbind(
        strategy_id = strategy_id,
        entry = centre$entry, exit = centre$exit,
        time_stop = if (is.infinite(stop_value)) "none" else as.character(stop_value),
        sizing_mode = sizing_design$sizing_mode[j],
        ema_half_life = sizing_design$ema_half_life[j],
        research_role = sizing_design$research_role[j],
        out$summary
      )
    }
  }
  sizing <- dplyr::bind_rows(sizing_rows)
  primary <- sizing[sizing$research_role == "primary" &
                      sizing$completed_trades >= OPT_MIN_TRADES, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(primary)) stop("No eligible primary sizing implementation: ", strategy_id)
  profitable <- primary[primary$net_futures_pnl > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  selection_pool <- if (nrow(profitable)) profitable else primary
  selection_pool <- selection_pool[order(-selection_pool$net_futures_pnl), , drop = FALSE]
  frozen <- selection_pool[1L, , drop = FALSE]
  frozen$positive_calibration_required_fallback <- !nrow(profitable)

  list(broad = broad, local = local, sizing = sizing, frozen = frozen)
}

# 5. Apply frozen rules once to the complete history

parse_stop <- function(x) if (identical(as.character(x), "none")) Inf else as.numeric(x)

run_frozen <- function(spec, score, execution, cost, label,
                       margin_scenario = "primary") {
  pos <- threshold_positions(score, spec$entry, spec$exit, parse_stop(spec$time_stop))
  weekly <- simulate_outright(
    execution, pos, cost, spec$sizing_mode, spec$ema_half_life,
    label, add_terminal_liquidation = TRUE,
    margin_scenario = margin_scenario
  )
  weekly$signal_score <- score
  list(position = pos, weekly = weekly)
}

  spec_deviation, z_deviation, execution_by_rank[["1"]], OPT_COSTS[["1"]], "DEV_CONTRARIAN_CL1"
)

period_labels <- function(dates) dplyr::case_when(
  dates <= OPT_CAL_END ~ "Calibration 2000-2016",
  dates >= OPT_OOS_START ~ "Retrospective OOS 2017-2025",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

summarise_period <- function(run_id, weekly, period_name, idx) {
  x <- weekly[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
  pnl <- x$net_futures_pnl
  weekly_return <- pnl / x$capital_start_week
  period_start_capital <- x$capital_start_week[1L]
  eq <- period_start_capital + cumsum(pnl)
  peak <- cummax(c(period_start_capital, eq))[-1L]
  drawdown <- eq - peak
  drawdown_flag <- drawdown < 0
  drawdown_runs <- rle(drawdown_flag)
  maximum_drawdown_duration <- if (any(drawdown_runs$values)) {
    max(drawdown_runs$lengths[drawdown_runs$values])
  } else 0L
  active <- x$direction != 0L
  positive_active_share <- if (any(active)) mean(pnl[active] > 0) else NA_real_
  gross_profit <- sum(pnl[pnl > 0])
  gross_loss <- abs(sum(pnl[pnl < 0]))
  account_return <- x$total_pnl / x$capital_start_week
  risk_free_return <- directional_ref$tbill_rate_weekly[
    match(x$date, directional_ref$date)
  ]
  account_excess_return <- account_return - risk_free_return
  account_peak <- cummax(
    c(period_start_capital, x$capital)
  )[-1L]
  account_drawdown <- x$capital - account_peak
  period_years <- nrow(x) / 52
  data.frame(
    run_id = run_id, period = period_name,
    start_date = min(x$date), end_date = max(x$date), weeks = nrow(x),
    start_capital = period_start_capital,
    end_capital = tail(x$capital, 1L),
    gross_futures_pnl = sum(x$gross_futures_pnl),
    transaction_cost = sum(x$transaction_cost),
    net_futures_pnl = sum(pnl),
    tbill_pnl = sum(x$tbill_pnl),
    total_account_pnl = sum(x$total_pnl),
    net_futures_return_on_start_pct = 100 * sum(pnl) / period_start_capital,
    annualized_mean_futures_return_pct = 100 * mean(weekly_return) * 52,
    annualized_futures_volatility_pct = 100 * stats::sd(weekly_return) * sqrt(52),
    information_ratio = if (stats::sd(weekly_return) > 0) {
      mean(weekly_return) / stats::sd(weekly_return) * sqrt(52)
    } else NA_real_,
    max_drawdown_dollars = min(drawdown),
    max_drawdown_pct = 100 * min(drawdown / peak),
    max_drawdown_duration_weeks = maximum_drawdown_duration,
    positive_active_week_share = positive_active_share,
    profit_factor = if (gross_loss > 0) gross_profit / gross_loss else NA_real_,
    best_week_pnl = max(pnl),
    worst_week_pnl = min(pnl),
    contract_sides = sum(x$contract_sides_traded),
    active_week_share = mean(active),
    average_contracts_when_active = if (any(x$contracts > 0)) mean(x$contracts[x$contracts > 0]) else 0,
    maximum_contracts = max(x$contracts),
    long_weeks = sum(x$direction > 0), short_weeks = sum(x$direction < 0),
    flat_weeks = sum(x$direction == 0),
    roll_weeks = sum(x$exec_roll),
    margin_cap_bindings = sum(x$margin_cap_binding),
    margin_entry_caps = sum(x$margin_entry_cap),
    margin_forced_reductions = sum(x$margin_forced_reduction),
    maintenance_margin_calls = sum(x$maintenance_margin_call),
    maximum_stress_margin_utilization = max(x$stress_margin_utilization_start),
    maximum_gross_notional_to_equity = max(x$gross_notional / x$capital_start_week),
    account_cagr_pct = 100 * (
      (tail(x$capital, 1L) / period_start_capital)^(1 / period_years) - 1
    ),
    annualized_account_volatility_pct =
      100 * stats::sd(account_return) * sqrt(52),
    account_sharpe_ratio = if (stats::sd(account_excess_return) > 0) {
      mean(account_excess_return) /
        stats::sd(account_excess_return) * sqrt(52)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    max_account_drawdown_pct = 100 * min(account_drawdown / account_peak),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

period_results <- list()

all_period_summaries <- function(run_list, result_type) {
  rows <- list()
  j <- 0L
  for (id in names(run_list)) {
    w <- run_list[[id]]$weekly
    for (definition in list(
      list(name = "Calibration 2000-2016", idx = w$date <= OPT_CAL_END),
      list(name = "Retrospective OOS 2017-2025", idx = w$date >= OPT_OOS_START),
      list(name = "Full 2000-2025", idx = rep(TRUE, nrow(w)))
    )) {
      j <- j + 1L
      rows[[j]] <- summarise_period(id, w, definition$name, definition$idx)
      rows[[j]]$result_type <- result_type
    }
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}

extract_episodes <- function(id, run_object) {
  pos <- run_object$position
  w <- run_object$weekly
  starts <- which(pos != 0L & pos != c(0L, head(pos, -1L)))
  if (!length(starts)) return(data.frame())
  rows <- lapply(seq_along(starts), function(j) {
    s <- starts[j]
    next_change <- which(seq_along(pos) > s & pos != pos[s])[1L]
    e <- if (is.na(next_change)) length(pos) else next_change - 1L
    data.frame(
      run_id = id, entry_date = w$date[s], exit_date = w$date[e],
      direction = pos[s], holding_weeks = e - s + 1L,
      gross_futures_pnl = sum(w$gross_futures_pnl[s:e]),
      transaction_cost = sum(w$transaction_cost[s:e]),
      net_futures_pnl = sum(w$net_futures_pnl[s:e]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
}
trade_episodes <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(frozen_runs), function(id) {
  extract_episodes(id, frozen_runs[[id]])
}))

  dplyr::group_by(run_id) |>

                   mean_holding_weeks = mean(holding_weeks),
                   maximum_holding_weeks = max(holding_weeks), .groups = "drop")

    best_year = year[which.max(net_futures_pnl)],
    best_year_pnl = max(net_futures_pnl),
    worst_year = year[which.min(net_futures_pnl)],
    worst_year_pnl = min(net_futures_pnl),
    largest_absolute_year_share = max(abs(net_futures_pnl)) / sum(abs(net_futures_pnl)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cost_sensitivity_frozen <- list()
j <- 0L
for (id in names(frozen_runs)) {
  w <- frozen_runs[[id]]$weekly
  for (period_name in c("Calibration 2000-2016", "Retrospective OOS 2017-2025", "Full 2000-2025")) {
    idx <- if (period_name == "Calibration 2000-2016") w$date <= OPT_CAL_END else
      if (period_name == "Retrospective OOS 2017-2025") w$date >= OPT_OOS_START else
        rep(TRUE, nrow(w))
    for (multiplier in c(0.5, 1, 2)) {
      j <- j + 1L
      cost <- sum(w$transaction_cost[idx]) * multiplier
      cost_sensitivity_frozen[[j]] <- data.frame(
        run_id = id, period = period_name, cost_multiplier = multiplier,
        gross_futures_pnl = sum(w$gross_futures_pnl[idx]),
        transaction_cost = cost,
        net_futures_pnl = sum(w$gross_futures_pnl[idx]) - cost
      )
    }
  }
}

  rank <- frozen_runs[[id]]$weekly$contract_rank[1L]

    forecast_signal_rows[[as.character(rank)]]$z_model_forecast
  historical_margin_runs[[id]] <- run_frozen(
    spec, score, execution_by_rank[[as.character(rank)]],
    OPT_COSTS[[as.character(rank)]], paste0(id, "_historical_margin"),
    margin_scenario = "historical"
  )
}
```

diagnostics, not extra selection criteria.

## Step 15: Thesis Main-Text Figures

The following plotting-only section creates the final main-text figures. It does
not refit the model, recalibrate a strategy, or overwrite the earlier diagnostic
figures. When the objects above are already available in the R environment, this
section can be rerun on its own.

```{r thesis-main-text-figures-final, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}

thesis_required_objects <- c(
  "raw_baseline_runs",
  "unit_frozen_runs",
  "always_long_unit_runs",
  "frozen_runs",
  "weekly_frozen",
  "unit_period_results",
  "always_long_benchmarks",
  "OPT_OOS_START",
  "PATH_OUTPUT"
)
thesis_missing_objects <- thesis_required_objects[
  !vapply(thesis_required_objects, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)
]
if (length(thesis_missing_objects) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The plotting section needs objects from the completed strategy run: ",
    paste(thesis_missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    ". Run the strategy through Section 12 once, then rerun this section only."
  )
}

# A common visual system is used for all main-text strategy figures.
thesis_colour_unoptimised <- "#7A7A7A"
thesis_colour_optimised <- "#1F6A5A"
thesis_colour_benchmark <- "#C47A3A"
thesis_colour_net_futures <- "#1F6A5A"
thesis_colour_total_account <- "#2F5597"
thesis_colour_drawdown <- "#2C7FB8"
thesis_maturity_colours <- c(
  "CL1" = "#1F6A5A",
  "CL5" = "#C47A3A",
  "CL9" = "#2F5597",
  "CL13" = "#8E6C8A",
  "CL17" = "#B5523B"
)

thesis_figure_theme <- function(base_size = 11) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold", colour = "#222222", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 3)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        colour = "#4A4A4A", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 9)
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#222222"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#3A3A3A"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#333333"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 14, 10, 10)
    )
}

# 53) Contrarian strategy: comparable one-contract OOS implementations.
thesis_contrarian_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  raw_baseline_runs[["RAW_DEV_CONTRARIAN_CL1"]]$weekly |>
    dplyr::mutate(specification = "Unoptimised one-contract signal"),
  unit_frozen_runs[["DEV_CONTRARIAN_CL1"]]$weekly |>
    dplyr::mutate(specification = "Optimised one-contract rule"),
  always_long_unit_runs[["AlwaysLong_CL1"]]$weekly |>
    dplyr::mutate(specification = "Always-long benchmark")
) |>
  dplyr::filter(date >= OPT_OOS_START) |>
  dplyr::group_by(specification) |>
  dplyr::arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cumulative_net_futures_pnl = cumsum(net_futures_pnl)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    specification = factor(
      specification,
      levels = c(
        "Unoptimised one-contract signal",
        "Optimised one-contract rule",
        "Always-long benchmark"
      )
    )
  )

thesis_contrarian_comparison_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  thesis_contrarian_comparison,
  ggplot2::aes(
    date,
    cumulative_net_futures_pnl / 1000,
    colour = specification
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Unoptimised one-contract signal" = thesis_colour_unoptimised,
    "Optimised one-contract rule" = thesis_colour_optimised,
    "Always-long benchmark" = thesis_colour_benchmark
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Short-term-deviation contrarian strategy",
    subtitle = "Out-of-sample comparison of one-contract implementations, 2017–2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative net futures P&L (USD thousands)"
  ) +
  thesis_figure_theme()

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "53_thesis_contrarian_one_contract_comparison.png"),
  thesis_contrarian_comparison_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# 54) Contrarian strategy: final cumulative performance and total-account drawdown.
thesis_contrarian_final_oos <- frozen_runs[["DEV_CONTRARIAN_CL1"]]$weekly |>
  dplyr::filter(date >= OPT_OOS_START) |>
  dplyr::arrange(date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cumulative_net_futures_pnl = cumsum(net_futures_pnl),
    cumulative_total_account_pnl = cumsum(total_pnl),
    account_peak = cummax(c(dplyr::first(capital_start_week), capital))[-1L],
    account_drawdown_pct = 100 * (capital / account_peak - 1)
  )

thesis_contrarian_final_lines <- thesis_contrarian_final_oos |>
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    `Net futures P&L` = cumulative_net_futures_pnl,
    `Total account P&L including Treasury income` = cumulative_total_account_pnl
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -date,
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "cumulative_pnl"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    series = factor(
      series,
      levels = c(
        "Net futures P&L",
        "Total account P&L including Treasury income"
      )
    )
  )

thesis_contrarian_performance_panel <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  thesis_contrarian_final_lines,
  ggplot2::aes(date, cumulative_pnl / 1000, colour = series)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Net futures P&L" = thesis_colour_net_futures,
    "Total account P&L including Treasury income" = thesis_colour_total_account
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Cumulative performance",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative P&L (USD thousands)"
  ) +
  thesis_figure_theme()

thesis_contrarian_drawdown_panel <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  thesis_contrarian_final_oos,
  ggplot2::aes(date, account_drawdown_pct)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_area(fill = thesis_colour_drawdown, alpha = 0.22) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(colour = thesis_colour_drawdown, linewidth = 0.65) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = "%")) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Total-account drawdown",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Drawdown"
  ) +
  thesis_figure_theme() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")

thesis_contrarian_final_figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  thesis_contrarian_performance_panel,
  thesis_contrarian_drawdown_panel,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1.35, 1),
  guides = "collect"
) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Final short-term-deviation contrarian strategy",
    subtitle = "Out-of-sample performance, 2017–2025",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "#222222"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, colour = "#4A4A4A")
    )
  ) &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "54_thesis_contrarian_final_performance_and_drawdown.png"),
  thesis_contrarian_final_figure,
  width = 9,
  height = 8.2,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# 55) Model-forecast strategy: optimised one-contract rules versus always-long benchmarks.
thesis_forecast_optimised_oos <- unit_period_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^MODEL_FORECAST_CL", run_id),
    grepl("OOS", period)
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    maturity = sub("MODEL_FORECAST_", "", run_id),
    optimised_pnl = net_futures_pnl
  )

thesis_forecast_benchmark_oos <- always_long_benchmarks |>
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^AlwaysLong_CL", run_id),
    grepl("OOS", period),
    sub("AlwaysLong_", "", run_id) %in% c("CL1", "CL5", "CL9", "CL13", "CL17")
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    maturity = sub("AlwaysLong_", "", run_id),
    benchmark_pnl = net_futures_pnl
  )

thesis_forecast_benchmark_comparison <- dplyr::inner_join(
  thesis_forecast_optimised_oos,
  thesis_forecast_benchmark_oos,
  by = "maturity"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    maturity = factor(
      maturity,
      levels = rev(c("CL1", "CL5", "CL9", "CL13", "CL17"))
    )
  )

thesis_forecast_benchmark_points <- thesis_forecast_benchmark_comparison |>
  dplyr::select(
    maturity,
    `Optimised one-contract rule` = optimised_pnl,
    `Always-long benchmark` = benchmark_pnl
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -maturity,
    names_to = "implementation",
    values_to = "net_futures_pnl"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    implementation = factor(
      implementation,
      levels = c("Optimised one-contract rule", "Always-long benchmark")
    )
  )

thesis_forecast_benchmark_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = thesis_forecast_benchmark_comparison,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = benchmark_pnl / 1000,
      xend = optimised_pnl / 1000,
      y = maturity,
      yend = maturity
    ),
    colour = "#B8B8B8",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = thesis_forecast_benchmark_points,
    ggplot2::aes(
      net_futures_pnl / 1000,
      maturity,
      colour = implementation,
      shape = implementation
    ),
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Optimised one-contract rule" = thesis_colour_optimised,
    "Always-long benchmark" = thesis_colour_benchmark
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Optimised one-contract rule" = 16,
    "Always-long benchmark" = 17
  )) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "One-week model-forecast strategy",
    subtitle = "Optimised one-contract rules versus always-long benchmarks, 2017–2025",
    x = "Net futures P&L (USD thousands)",
    y = "Contract maturity",
    colour = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  thesis_figure_theme()

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "55_thesis_forecast_one_contract_benchmark_comparison.png"),
  thesis_forecast_benchmark_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# 56) Model-forecast strategy: final OOS cumulative net futures P&L.
thesis_forecast_oos_cumulative <- weekly_frozen |>
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl("^MODEL_FORECAST_CL", run_id),
    date >= OPT_OOS_START
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(run_id) |>
  dplyr::arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cumulative_net_futures_pnl = cumsum(net_futures_pnl)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    maturity = factor(
      sub("MODEL_FORECAST_", "", run_id),
      levels = c("CL1", "CL5", "CL9", "CL13", "CL17")
    )
  )

thesis_forecast_oos_cumulative_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  thesis_forecast_oos_cumulative,
  ggplot2::aes(
    date,
    cumulative_net_futures_pnl / 1000,
    colour = maturity
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = thesis_maturity_colours,
    breaks = c("CL1", "CL5", "CL9", "CL13", "CL17")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Final one-week model-forecast strategies",
    subtitle = "Out-of-sample cumulative net futures P&L, 2017–2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative net futures P&L (USD thousands)",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  thesis_figure_theme() +
  ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "56_thesis_forecast_oos_cumulative_net_futures_pnl.png"),
  thesis_forecast_oos_cumulative_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

thesis_contrarian_comparison_plot
thesis_contrarian_final_figure
thesis_forecast_benchmark_plot
thesis_forecast_oos_cumulative_plot
```
